tests.result: Asset, Map, Content and Project APIs detected; engine 14.1.0
Runtime definition and procedural asset slot created
Same-floor rejected; underA/underB and terrain restored by undo
PNG moved to new monster asset ID
Monster, dependent quest and spawn removed
Content, map references and custom PNG restored/removed together
Five floors reachable; gates and spawn progression pass
Unknown ghost spawn rejected without mutation
Remote URL and invalid package rejected
ZIP 45 PNG + manifest; project and standalone build reload correctly
Memory fallback restores state when IndexedDB is unavailable

knownLimitations: New active skill mechanics require a registered executor.
New talent identifiers do not automatically gain engine behavior.
Quest support is currently focused on simple kill-count quests.
Items, equipment and NPC dialogue are not exposed through Content API.
The application remains a large single-file architecture.
The iframe must only load trusted game HTML because allow-scripts + allow-same-origin is not a security boundary.
